ordered_prerequisites.name: approved_human_governance_decision
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: authenticated decision with APPROVE_FIRST_TRANCHE24_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PREPARATION, APPROVE_CONDITIONAL_CANONICAL_SOURCE_MANIFEST_ADMISSION, or APPROVE_BOTH_G1_AND_G2 as applicable

ordered_prerequisites.name: immutable_source_artifact_identity
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: artifact identity plus immutable release/version/commit/tree identity and recomputable SHA-256

ordered_prerequisites.name: authenticated_acquisition_evidence
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: signed release, pinned signed commit/tree, or approved equivalent immutable content-addressed acquisition proof and independent verifier

ordered_prerequisites.name: deterministic_exact_one_object_extraction
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: pinned extractor identity/version/hash, exact locator, locator hash, and cardinality exactly one

ordered_prerequisites.name: authenticated_source_object_hash
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: source-object bytes and SHA-256 recomputed from the immutable artifact and extractor

ordered_prerequisites.name: authenticated_schema_identity
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: schema namespace and identity/version/hash authenticated against the source object

ordered_prerequisites.name: exact_rfc6901_pointer_resolution
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: one exact RFC6901 pointer that resolves on the authenticated object

ordered_prerequisites.name: field_type_and_semantics_match
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: field type and canonical intrinsic field semantics ID match the authorized schema contract

ordered_prerequisites.name: canonical_value_hash_recomputation
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: canonicalization profile and recomputed authenticated canonical value SHA-256

ordered_prerequisites.name: no_revocation_or_supersession_conflict
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: independent conflict check over authority, owner, artifact, object, schema, and field lineage

ordered_prerequisites.name: independent_manifest_admission_review
ordered_prerequisites.required_record: independent reviewer recomputation and signed review disposition

SOURCE_MANIFEST_ENTRY_READY_FOR_REVIEW.meaning: all preparatory evidence is assembled for independent admission review; no authority or operative entry is created

SOURCE_MANIFEST_ENTRY_ADMITTED_OPERATIVE.meaning: all gates pass and a separately governed admission transaction is recorded
